o1: Predicted to enable myosin heavy chain binding activity; contributes to myosin II activity; and predicted to enable myosin light chain activity. Involved in ovulation; embryonic body morphogenesis; cytoskeleton-dependent cytokinesis; and nematode larval development. Is located in cytoplasm and cleavage furrow. Is part of filamentous actin. Is expressed in myoepithelial sheath and hypodermis. Is part of the Rho-1 signaling pathway. Predicted to interact with NMY-2. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in familial hypertrophic cardiomyopathy and megacystis-microcolon-intestinal hypoperistalsis syndrome. Orthologous to several human genes including MYL9 (myosin light chain 9).
